morning.title: Sayyidul Istighfar
morning.banner: The Morning Adhkar – Ideally recited between Fajr and Sunrise
morning.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
morning.translit: Allaahuma anta rabbee laailaaha illa ant, khalaqtanee wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata'tu, a'oodhu bika min sharri maa sana'tu, aboo-u laka bini'matika 'alayya wa aboo-u bidhanbee, faghfir lee fa-innahu laa yaghfirudh-dhunooba illaa ant
morning.meaning: Sayyidul Istighfaar: Master Supplication for Forgiveness, acknowledging Allah's blessings, confessing sins, and asking for pardon.

morning.title: Tahlil & Sovereignty
morning.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
morning.translit: Laa ilaaha illal-laahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
morning.meaning: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone Who has no partner. Sovereignty and praise belong to Him, and He is Able to do all things.
morning.repeat: Recited 10 times in morning / 100 times daily

morning.title: Tasbeeh & Hamd
morning.meaning: Glory is to Allah and Praise is to Him.

morning.title: Protection from All Harm
morning.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
morning.translit: Bismillaahil-ladhee laa yadurru ma'as-mihi shay'un fil-ardi wa laa fis-samaa'i wa huwas-samee'ul-'aleem
morning.meaning: In the Name of Allah, with Whose Name nothing can cause harm on earth or in heaven, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

morning.title: Supplication for Well-being ('Afiyah)
morning.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ، وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
morning.translit: Allaahumma innee as'alukal-'aafiyata fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirah, Allaahumma innee as'alukal-'afwa wal-'aafiyata fee deenee wa dunyaaya wa ahlee wa maalee, Allaahummas-tur 'awraatee wa aamin raw'aatee, Allaahummah-fadhnee min bayni yadayya wa min khalfee wa 'an yameenee wa 'an shimaalee wa min fawqee, wa a'oodhu bi-'adhamatika an ughtaala min tahtee
morning.meaning: O Allah, I seek Your pardon and well-being in my faith, worldly affairs, family, and wealth; conceal my faults, calm my fears, and protect me from all sides.

morning.title: Surah Al-Ikhlas
morning.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
morning.translit: Bismillaahir-rahmaanir-raheem. Qul huwal-laahu ahad. Allaahus-samad. Lam yalid wa lam yoolad. Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad
morning.meaning: Surah Al-Ikhlas: Say, He is Allah, [who is] One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, nor is there to Him any equivalent.

morning.title: Surah Al-Falaq
morning.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
morning.translit: Bismillaahir-rahmaanir-raheem. Qul a'oodhu birabbil-falaq. Min sharri maa khalaq. Wa min sharri ghaasiqin idhaa waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffaathaati fil-'uqad. Wa min sharri haasidin idhaa hasad
morning.meaning: Surah Al-Falaq: Seeking refuge in the Lord of the daybreak from created harm, darkness when it settles, the blowers in knots, and the envier when he envies.

morning.title: Surah An-Nas
morning.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۝ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۝ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
morning.translit: Bismillaahir-rahmaanir-raheem. Qul a'oodhu birabbin-naas. Malikin-naas. Ilaahin-naas. Min sharril-waswaasil-khannaas. Alladhee yuwaswisu fee sudoorin-naas. Minal-jinnati wan-naas
morning.meaning: Surah An-Nas: Seeking refuge in the Lord, Sovereign, and God of mankind from the retreating whisperer in the hearts of mankind.

morning.title: Pleasure with Allah & Islam
morning.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا
morning.translit: Radeetu billaahi rabban, wa bil-islaami deenan, wa bi-muhammadin sallallaahu 'alayhi wa sallama nabiyyaa
morning.meaning: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, Islam as my religion, and Muhammad ﷺ as my Prophet.

morning.title: Refuge from Self & Satan
morning.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَشَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِي سُوءًا، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَىٰ مُسْلِمٍ
morning.translit: Allaahumma faatiras-samaawaati wal-ard, 'aalimal-ghaybi wash-shahaadah, rabba kulli shay'in wa maleekah, ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illaa ant, a'oodhu bika min sharri nafsee wa sharri-shaytaani wa shirkih, wa an aqtarifa 'alaa nafsee soo-an aw ajurrahu ilaa muslim
morning.meaning: O Allah, Creator of heaven and earth, Knower of unseen and seen, I seek refuge in You from the evil of myself, Satan, his polytheism, and harming any Muslim.

morning.title: Supplication to the Ever-Living
morning.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَىٰ نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
morning.translit: Yaa hayyu yaa qayyoom, bi-rahmatika astagheeth, aslih lee sha'nee kullahu wa laa takilnee ilaa nafsee tarfata 'ayn
morning.meaning: O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining, by Your mercy I seek help; rectify all of my affairs and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.

morning.title: Entering the Morning
morning.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَٰذَا الْيَوْمِ، وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَٰذَا الْيَوْمِ، وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ، وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
morning.translit: Asbahnaa wa asbahal-mulku lillaah, wal-hamdu lillaah, laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer, rabbi as-aluka khayra maa fee haadhal-yawmi wa khayra maa ba'dahu, wa a'oodhu bika min sharri maa fee haadhal-yawmi wa sharri maa ba'dahu, rabbi a'oodhu bika minal-kasali wa soo-il-kibar, rabbi a'oodhu bika min 'adhaabin fin-naari wa 'adhaabin fil-qabr
morning.meaning: We have reached the morning and the kingdom belongs to Allah. O Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and what follows it, and seek refuge from laziness and torment of Hell or grave.

morning.title: Affirming Morning by Allah's Will
morning.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
morning.translit: Allaahumma bika asbahnaa, wa bika amsaynaa, wa bika nahyaa, wa bika namootu wa ilaykan-nushoor
morning.meaning: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and die, and unto You is our resurrection.

morning.title: Glorification by Weight of Creation
morning.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
morning.translit: Subhaanallaahi wa bi-hamdihi, 'adada khalqihi, wa ridaa nafsihi, wa zinata 'arshihi, wa midaada kalimaatih
morning.meaning: Glory and praise be to Allah as many times as the count of His creation, according to His good pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and ink of His words.

morning.title: Natural State of Islam
morning.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَىٰ فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ وَعَلَىٰ كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ وَعَلَىٰ دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ وَعَلَىٰ مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
morning.translit: Asbahnaa 'alaa fitratil-islaami wa 'alaa kalimatil-ikhlaas, wa 'alaa deeni nabiyyinaa Muhammadin ﷺ, wa 'alaa millati abeenaa Ibraaheema haneefan musliman wa maa kaana minal-mushrikeen
morning.meaning: We have reached morning upon the pristine religion of Islam, the declaration of sincerity, the faith of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and the upright creed of Ibrahim.

morning.title: Sufficiency in Allah
morning.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
morning.translit: Hasbiyallaahu laa ilaaha illaa huwa 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa rabbul-'arshil-'adheem
morning.meaning: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no deity worthy of worship except Him. In Him I place my trust, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.

evening.title: Sayyidul Istighfar
evening.banner: The Evening Adhkar – To be recited in the Evening, ideally between 'Asr and Maghrib
evening.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
evening.translit: Allaahuma anta rabbee laailaaha illa ant, khalaqtanee wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika masta-ta'tu, a'uthubika min sharri ma sana'tu, abu-u laka bi ni'matika 'alayya, wa abu-u bi-dhambi, faghfirlee finnahu laa yaghfiru-dhunooba illa ant
evening.meaning: Sayyidul Istighfaar: Master Supplication for Forgiveness. Acknowledging Allah's Lordship and blessings, repenting for sins, and seeking divine forgiveness.

evening.title: Tahlil & Sovereignty
evening.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
evening.translit: Laa ilaaha illal-laahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul mulku wa-lahul hamdu wa-huwa 'ala kulli shayin qadeer
evening.meaning: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone Who has no partner. Sovereignty and praise belong to Him, and He has full power over all things.
evening.repeat: Recited 10 times and 100 times anytime throughout the day

evening.title: Tasbeeh & Praise
evening.meaning: Glory is to Allah and Praise is to Him.

evening.title: Protection from Harm
evening.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
evening.translit: Bismillaahil-ladhi laa yadduru ma'a ismihi shayun fil-ardi walaa fis-samaai wa-huwas samee'ul 'aleem
evening.meaning: In the Name of Allah, Who with His Name nothing can cause harm in the Earth nor in the Heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
evening.ref: Musnad Imam Ahmad 446 and Sunan al-Tirmidhi 3388

evening.title: Supplication for Well-being ('Afiyah)
evening.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ، وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
evening.translit: Allaahuma inni asalukal aafiyata fid-dunya wal aakhirah, Allaahuma inni asalukal 'afwa wal 'aafiyata fee deenee wa dunyaay, wa ahlee wa maalee, Allahumas tur 'awratee, wa-aamin raw'aatee, Allahumahfathnee min bayni yaday, wa-min khalfee, wa-'an yameenee, wa-'an shimaalee, wa-min fawqee, wa a'udhu bi-'adhamatika an ughtaala min tahtee
evening.meaning: O Allah, I seek Your protection and pardon in this world and the next, in my faith, worldly affairs, family, and wealth; conceal my faults, secure my fears, and guard me from every direction.

evening.title: Surah Al-Ikhlas
evening.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
evening.translit: Bismillaah-hirahmaan-nirraheem. Qul huwal-laahu Ahad. Allaahus samad. Lam yalid wa lam yuwlad. Wa lam yakul-lahu kuf-fuw-wan Ahad
evening.meaning: Surah Al-Ikhlas: Say, He is Allah, One and Indivisible. Allah, the Sustainer needed by all. He has never had offspring, nor was He born, and none is comparable to Him.

evening.title: Surah Al-Falaq
evening.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
evening.translit: Bismillaah-hirahmaan-nirraheem. Qul 'audhu birabbil falaq. Min sharri maa khalaq. Wa min sharri ghaasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin naffa-thaati fil 'uqad. Wa min sharri haasidin idha hasad
evening.meaning: Surah Al-Falaq: Seeking refuge in the Lord of the daybreak from created harm, dark night, witchcraft, and the envious.

evening.title: Surah An-Nas
evening.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۝ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۝ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
evening.translit: Bismillaah-hirahmaan-nirraheem. Qul 'audhu birabbin naas. Malikin-naas. Ilaahin-naas. Min sharril waswaasil khannaas. El-ledhi yuwas-wisu fee sudoorin-naas. Minal jin-nati wan-naas
evening.meaning: Surah An-Nas: Seeking refuge in the Lord, Master, and God of humankind from the lurking whisperer among jinn and men.

evening.title: Contentment with Allah & His Messenger
evening.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا
evening.translit: Radeetu billaahi rabban, wa-bil islaami deenan, wa-bi muhammadin sallal-laahu 'alayhi wa sallama nabeeyyan
evening.meaning: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my Religion, and with Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him) as my Prophet.

evening.title: Seeking Refuge from Evil & Satan
evening.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لا إِلَهَ إِلا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَشَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
evening.translit: Allaahuma faatiras samaa-waati wal ard, 'aalimal ghaybi washa-haadah, rabba kulli shayin wa maleekah, ash-hadu allaa-ilaaha illa ant, a'udhu bika min sharri nafsee, wa sharrish shaytaani wa shirkih, wa-an aktarifa 'alaa nafsee sooan, aw ajjuruhu ila muslim
evening.meaning: O Allah, Creator of the Heavens and Earth, Knower of unseen and evident, Lord and Possessor of all things. I seek refuge from the evil of my soul, Satan, his helpers, and from harming any Muslim.

evening.title: Supplication to the Ever-Living
evening.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ وَلا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
evening.translit: Yaa hayuu yaa qayyoom, bi-rahmatika astagheeth, uslih-lee sha-nee kullahu wa-laa takil-nee ila nafsee tarfata 'ayn
evening.meaning: O Ever Living One, O All-Sustaining One, by Your mercy I call on You to set right all of my affairs; do not place me in charge of my soul even for the blinking of an eye.

evening.title: Entering the Evening
evening.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لا إِلَهَ إِلا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ، وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ، وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ، وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
evening.translit: Amsaynaa wa-amsal mulku lillah, wal hamdu lillah, laa ilaaha ilal -laahu wahdahoo laa shareeka lah, lahul mulku, wa-lahul hamdu wa-huwa 'ala kulli shayin qadeer, rabbi as-aluka khayra maa fee hadhi-hil laylah, wa khayra ma b'adahaa, wa 'audhu bika min sharri maa fee hadhi-hil laylah, wa sharri maa b'adahaa, rabbi 'audhu bika minal kasal, wa-sooil kibar, rabbi 'audu bika min 'adhaabin fin-naari wa 'adhaabin fil qabr
evening.meaning: We have entered the evening and all sovereignty belongs to Allah. My Lord, I ask You for the goodness of this night and what comes after it, and seek refuge from its evil, laziness, old-age feebleness, and punishment of Hellfire and grave.

evening.title: Affirming Evening by Allah's Will
evening.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
evening.translit: Allahumma bika amsaynaa, wa-bika asbahnaa, wa-bika nahyaa, wa-bika namootu, wa-ilaykal maseer
evening.meaning: O Allah, by You we enter the evening and by You we enter the morning, by You we live and by You we die, and unto You is our final return.

evening.title: Sufficiency in Allah
evening.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
evening.translit: Hasbeeyal-laahu laa ilaaha illa huwa 'alayhi tawakaltu wa-huwa rabbul 'arshil 'adheem
evening.meaning: Sufficient for me is Allah; there is no deity except Him. Upon Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.

evening.title: Refuge in Allah's Perfect Words
evening.banner: Recited in the evening for protection from harm and poisonous creatures
evening.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
evening.translit: A'udhu bikalimaatil-laahit taam-maati min sharri maa khalaq
evening.meaning: I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
evening.repeat: Recited Once only in the evening

evening.title: Last Two Verses of Surah Al-Baqarah
evening.banner: The last two verses of Surah Al-Baqarah are to be recited after the sun has set and not before
evening.arabic: ءَامَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِۦ ۚ وَقَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ ۝ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَآ ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَٰفِرِينَ
evening.translit: 285. Aamanar rasoolu bimaa oonzila ilayhi mir-rabbihi wal mu'minoon, kulun aamana billaahi wa malaaikatihi wa kutubihi wa rousulih, laa noufarriqu bayna ahadim mir-rousulih, wa qaalou sami'naa wa-ata'naa ghufraanaka rabbanaa wa ilaykal maser. 286. Laa yukalliful-laahu nafsan illaa wus'aha, lahaa ma kasabat wa'alayhaa mak tasabat, rabbanaa laa tu-aa-khidhnaa inn naseenaa aw akhta'naa, rabbanaa wa-laa tahmil 'alaynaa isran kaa hamaltahu 'alal ladheena min qablinaa, rabbanaa wa-laa tuham-milnaa maa laa taaqata lana bih, wa'fu 'annaa, waghfir lanaa, war-hamnaa, anta mawlaanaa fansurnaa 'alal qawmil kaafireen
evening.meaning: Verses 285-286 of Surah Al-Baqarah. The Prophet ﷺ mentioned that whoever recites these two verses at night, they will suffice him (as protection against all harm).
